subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add an off-by-default agent/default config contract for suppressing the human-readable Tooling list, or should this token reduction stay inside broader prompt/tool-schema optimization work?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a new config/prompt contract and root policy requires maintainer intent before expanding that surface.

options.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
options.body: Implement a narrow off-by-default option that omits only the Tooling list and keeps callable schemas and diagnostics intact.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Token Work
options.body: Make the broader tool-schema/context optimization issue the canonical product design while preserving this issue as linked context until that design is accepted.

options.title: Reject New Config Surface
options.body: Close this direction after maintainers decide existing prompt controls and broader context optimizations are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow off-by-default option that omits only the Tooling list and keeps callable schemas and diagnostics intact.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest inspected routing candidate for prompt construction and the prior maintainer-side review on this item.
